messages:
jess: Heads-up — seeing a ~10x bump in 401s from the ruby sampleapp during token rotation in staging this morning. Looks like the streaming client keeps an old Authorization header for a short window after refresh.

kai: oh interesting — is this the non-blocking stream client or the blocking one?

jess: non-blocking (Net::HTTP persistent + EventMachine wrapper). I can repro locally by forcing an early rotation: EARLY_REFRESH=1 and then starting a long-running stream.

ana: can you paste a mini repro or the specific log lines?

jess: sure — minimal repro I used:
```ruby
# start a long stream loop with forced refresh
client = Redwood::Client.new(token: ENV['TEMP_TOKEN'])
client.stream("chat.completions") do |msg|
  # rotate token in separate process then continue reading
  puts msg
end
```
logs show repeated `401 Unauthorized` from the stream socket, then it recovers after 2–3s when the library reopens the connection.

sam: we saw a similar thing in the Go SDK where the socket kept old headers; we fixed by explicitly reattaching headers on reconnect. Might be same class of bug: header cached on connection object.

kai: quick possible fix: on stream error 401, call refresh_token! and force the socket to reinitialize. Something like:
```ruby
if resp.code == '401'
  refresh_token! # updates cached header
  reconnect_stream
end
```

jess: I put up a tiny PR that catches 401 and clears the cached auth header before reconnecting — tests pass locally. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/412 (small branch: jb/stream-rotation-fix). Need a reviewer to confirm no sync-client regression.

ana: :eyes: assigning to @kai for review. Also add a tiny integration test in the sampleapp that rotates the token mid-stream so we don't regress.

kai: on it. If it's indeed low-risk we should backport to v1.x as a patch. Please add a changelog line and note in the quickstart troubleshooting doc about stale headers during token rotation.

devex-bot: CI update — unit matrix: ruby-3.1 ✅, jruby-9.3 ✅, macos-arm queued (flaky test rerun).

sam: :thumbsup: once QA gives green on staging run, merge + cut patch. Also let's add an explicit comment in the streaming README about token lifetimes and recommended refresh window.

jess: will add the test + changelog today, thanks everyone :pray:
